assetPolicy: Original procedural models. Official photographs are visual references only; no photograph or downloaded mesh is shipped in the world assets.
accuracy: A playable, flattened outdoor interpretation of three neighbourhoods around McKeldin Mall. Relative campus directions are preserved; distances, footprints, facades and gardens are simplified rather than surveyed. Building interiors are not included.
coordinateSystem: Metres. East +x, south +z, McKeldin Mall centre [0,0].

map.publisher: University of Maryland Conferences & Visitor Services / Facilities Management
map.locations: Stamp northwest of the mall; Reckord Armory east/northeast; Memorial Chapel southeast. The in-game neighbourhood layout compresses distances.

landmarks.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
landmarks.interpretation: Broad red-brick student union with lower central mass, taller end pavilions, a stone-framed glazed entry, sheltered forecourt, bicycle stands, seating and planters. Facade dimensions are authored, not measured.

landmarks.name: Reckord Armory
landmarks.interpretation: Long white columned front, substantial molded entablature, triangular pediment with round window, red-brick hall and broad ceremonial stair. Main dimensions are compressed for the outdoor walk.

landmarks.name: Memorial Chapel
landmarks.interpretation: Red-brick nave and arched windows, a four-column front with layered moldings, clock tower, louvered belfry and slender steeple. The adjoining wing and quiet circular garden are simplified outdoor compositions.

construction.facades: Extruded wall shells contain actual window and door openings. Glass and wood panels sit behind 0.65-metre reveals with separate jambs, sills, transoms and muntins.
construction.geometry: Repeated parts are merged by material and ground/detail role. No downloaded models and no individually modeled brick walls.
construction.playability: Six-metre or wider main pedestrian loop, separate low stair ground surfaces, invisible building and furniture collision, and lawn-only grass footprints.
